build_substr_matching_automaton: build an Aho-Corasick automaton from a list of metadata keyword strings for fast multi-pattern matching
run_substr_matching: run substring matching against text using an Aho-Corasick automaton to find all matching metadata entry IDs
test_substr_matching: test the substr_matching function by passing sample text and metadata and verifying returned entry IDs
refactor_initialize_automaton: refactor initialize_automaton to accept spaced metadata directly instead of relying on a global variable
review_substr_matching: review the substr_matching function and its lazy initialization of the global automaton and spaced metadata
